subject: RFP benchmark — competitive subsidy match request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cognitohealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: CognitoHealth Procurement <procurement@cognitohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: RFP: inference benchmark — subsidy conversation

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. We're narrowing our vendor shortlist for the upcoming RFP bake-off, and I wanted to be transparent about competitive subsidies. One of the other vendors proposed a front-loaded evaluation credit (6 weeks worth of compute) and some engineering hours to accelerate integration.

Procurement asked whether Redwood would consider an equivalent credit to participate fairly in the benchmark. The RFP timeline is tight (bench windows start Aug 22), so we're looking for a quick yes/no plus the outline of terms (duration, usage cap, and any gating like NDA or SOC2 evidence). I've attached the RFP summary for context.

Can you let me know if Redwood can match a short evaluation subsidy, and what the turnaround is on paperwork?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering
CognitoHealth

Attachments: RFP_CognitoHealth_summary.pdf (application/pdf, 230KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cognitohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: RFP: inference benchmark — subsidy conversation

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and for sharing the RFP.

We can absolutely be flexible to ensure a level playing field. At a high level we can offer a timeboxed evaluation credit plus prioritized onboarding support. Before I lock in details with Procurement, a couple quick clarifying Qs so we size the offer correctly:

- What scope does the competitor credit cover (per-token compute only, or also storage/managed connectors)?
- Expected peak concurrency and target sequence lengths for the benchmark (helps with capacity reservation).
- Will Cognito require a written credit agreement or is a simple PO sufficient?

If it's okay, I'll loop in Marissa and Ben to get an internal approval path and confirm the credit envelope. If we can move quickly we can have a term sheet by early next week.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: CognitoHealth RFP — request for matching evaluation credit

Team — quick heads-up: CognitoHealth asked if we can match a competitor's 6-week evaluation credit for their upcoming benchmark (RFP-8421). Timeline: bench windows open Aug 22, decision late Sep.

Proposal I'm recommending to accelerate the deal:
- Offer: 6-week evaluation credit equivalent to $28k of projected token spend (prepaid credit applied to Cognito account).
- Support: 12 hours of onboarding time (solutions eng office hours) scoped to integrate their data pipeline and run two benchmark runs.
- Conditions: NDA signed + single SOC2 evidence package review, credit expires 8 weeks after issuance, usage cap enforced by billing guardrails.

Operational asks: can ops create a temporary 'eval-credit' code and a short credit agreement? Ben, can you confirm the $28k number vs. our expected unit economics and flag any objections. Soojin, can legal prepare a tight redline we can attach to DocuSign (no unusual indemnities) — we need to move fast.

I've attached a straw-man comms/commission structure for approval. If Marissa can sign off, I'll send the term sheet to Cognito and run DocuSign.

Jordan

Attachments: proposed_comm_structure.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Aug 2028 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: CognitoHealth RFP — request for matching evaluation credit

Jordan —

Agree with the approach. A couple of guardrails before we send anything external:

1) Credit cap at $28k as proposed, tied to a single account; no transfer or stacking.
2) Credit issued only after NDA and a completed SOC2 questionnaire intake; we can accept their SOC2 self-attest initially but require evidence if they proceed to PO.
3) Onboarding hours are limited to 12 and must be scheduled within the 6-week window.

Ben — confirm that $28k will keep the deal within our churn-adjusted LTV threshold; if not, flag an alternative (shorter duration or lower credit).
Soojin — please prepare a 1-page credit addendum and a redline that references our standard trial terms — minimal legal friction.

If Ben confirms by EOD tomorrow I'll approve and Jordan can send the term sheet with DocuSign link to Cognito.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2028 18:02:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood evaluation offer for CognitoHealth (RFP-8421) — term sheet + next steps

Hi Liam — thanks for the patience. Following internal approvals, please find the offer below:

Summary of evaluation credit:
- Credit value: $28,000 applied to CognitoHealth's Redwood account (single account only).
- Duration: 6-week evaluation window, credit expires 8 weeks after issuance.
- Support: 12 hours of onboarding & benchmarking support (scheduling required within eval window).
- Conditions: NDA signed + SOC2 questionnaire intake completed prior to credit issuance; standard trial addendum applies.

Deliverables and logistics:
- I'll issue a DocuSign packet with: 1) 1-page credit addendum, 2) trial statement of work, 3) acceptance checklist. Please review and sign; once signed we'll provision the credit and book onboarding time with our Solutions Eng team.
- Link to sign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ef12ab34-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-abcdef123456
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421-RFP-8421

Attachments: trial-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 38KB); PoC-Statement.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 14KB)

If you want changes to the window or the support scope, flag them now — otherwise we'll circulate the DocuSign and aim to provision credit within 24 hours of signed agreement.

Thanks and looking forward to running the benchmark with you.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
